description: Cefic Facts and Figures is the annual statistical profile of the European chemical industry. The 2025 edition has chapters on the industry profile, with sales by end market, country and sector and its share of world sales; trade, with extra-EU trade flows, balances and top export and import markets; growth and competitiveness, with output, capacity utilisation, production by country, employment and labour productivity; the industry's contribution to EU manufacturing; energy consumption by source, energy efficiency and European versus US natural gas prices; and capital and research spending. It is compiled by Cefic, the European Chemical Industry Council, from public statistical sources such as Eurostat, the European Commission and the European Environment Agency. Coverage is the EU27 with its member states and comparisons with world regions, annual from 2004 to 2024. The charts are available free as a PowerPoint download and the underlying data as an xls file. Caveats: it is an industry association publication, the page read gives no licence, and figures are regularly revised as sources update. It reports turnover of 635 billion euros, 1.2 million employees, a 13% global share against 46% for China and gas prices three times US levels. For simulation it gives sector-level output, trade and energy data to calibrate economic and supply chain resilience models of chemical production. It is related to the Global Petrochemical Map record in this catalogue.
